name: Winter Break
source:
After admin did a questionable archiving decision, you've been assigned to be a student teacher at a new city for about four days just before Christmas, and then back up again next year. With a new city comes meeting new people, and with meeting new people comes a bit of awkwardness, emotional baggage and holiday cheer!

You'll come to meet your mentor (but still a newbie) teacher, Rüdiger, an easily excited tiger who's the owner of a ramen restaurant, Torataro, and a moody bear that doesn't quite along with other people, Oliver.

They're not perfect, but they're quite charming, I'd say.

[From [url=https://broyi.itch.io/winter-break]Itch.io[/url]]
